title: RDS Instance Publicly Accessible
rag_framework: AWS Well-Architected Framework — Security Pillar, CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v5.0.0
llm_guidance:
RDS instance is publicly accessible, exposing it to potential brute-force and exploitation attempts from the internet.
Update the RDS instance to use a VPC and set publicly_accessible to False, then enable RDS storage encryption using AWS KMS, and update the parameter group to require SSL/TLS for client connections by setting require_secure_transport to 1.

title: RDS Instance Publicly Accessible
rag_framework: AWS Well-Architected Framework — Security Pillar, CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v5.0.0
llm_guidance:
RDS instances are publicly accessible, exposing them to potential security threats and exploitation attempts.
To remediate, create an encrypted snapshot of the RDS instance, then restore a new instance from it, ensuring it's not publicly accessible and has SSL/TLS enabled for client connections.

title: Storage Account Reachable From Any Network
rag_framework: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A — Technological Controls, Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark
llm_guidance:
Data in Azure Storage is exposed to the open internet, allowing unauthorized access.
Change the public_network_access setting to "Disabled" in the Azure Storage account configuration, and consider implementing a firewall scoped to selected VNets/IPs for additional security.

title: Storage Account Allows Public Blob Access
rag_framework: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A — Technological Controls, Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark
llm_guidance:

Set allowBlobPublicAccess to false in the Azure Storage account settings, and restrict network access by setting publicNetworkAccess to Disabled or configuring a firewall scoped to selected VNets/IPs.

title: Security Group Allows SSH (22) from 0.0.0.0/0
llm_guidance:
Unrestricted SSH access from the internet poses a significant risk to the security of your EC2 instances.
Update the security group to restrict SSH access to only trusted IP addresses, such as a bastion host or VPN CIDR range, by modifying the group's inbound rules to use a more specific IP range or by creating a new rule that only allows SSH access from the trusted IP addresses.
